definitions.gloss: dropping out, leaving school before graduation
definitions.explanation: Withdrawing from a school or university before completing the course of study. Short for {中途|ちゅうと}{退学|たいがく}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{中退|ちゅうたい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧{中退|ちゅうたい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧になった。
examples.english: He went from high school dropout to company president.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済的|けいざいてき}→経済的：05675_keizaiteki⟧な⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{中退|ちゅうたい}⟦せざる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}なかった→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: I had no choice but to drop out of college for financial reasons.

notes:
FORMS:
Short for ⟦{中途|ちゅうと}→中途：04521_chuuto⟧⟦{退学|たいがく}→退学：03387_taigaku⟧ (leaving school midway).

USAGE:
On resumes, {中退|ちゅうたい} is listed after the school name (e.g., 〇〇⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{中退|ちゅうたい}). It is not inherently negative and some successful people are known as {中退|ちゅうたい}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{中退|ちゅうたい}: college dropout
- ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧{中退|ちゅうたい}: high school dropout
- {中退|ちゅうたい}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: person who dropped out
- {中退|ちゅうたい}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: dropout rate
